data.name: Focused Mount
data.description: Your mount gains the Wild Talent feat.  In addition, you and your mount are treated as maintaining psionic focus if either one is maintaining psionic focus.

raw_tokens.value: Your mount gains the Wild Talent feat.  In addition, you and your mount are treated as maintaining psionic focus if either one is maintaining psionic focus.

You can expend your mount's psionic focus to power a psionic feat you possess.  Should you have an additional focus available, such as from the Psicrystal Containment feat, you can use it in conjunction with this ability.|PRECLASS:1,Psychic Warrior=15
